# AttestoPhoenix v0.19.1 - Table of Contents

> Phoenix/Ecto OAuth 2.0 / OIDC authorization server layer over attesto: authorization, token, PAR, revocation, discovery, JWKS, UserInfo, protected-resource plugs, and Ecto-backed token stores.

## Modules

- [AttestoPhoenix.AuthorizationServer.DeviceAuthorization](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.AuthorizationServer.DeviceAuthorization.md): Device authorization request processing (RFC 8628 §3.1 / §3.2), as conn-free
core.
- [AttestoPhoenix.AuthorizationServer.DeviceAuthorization.Request](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.AuthorizationServer.DeviceAuthorization.Request.md): Plain-data device-authorization request the controller builds from the conn.
- [AttestoPhoenix.AuthorizationServer.JwtBearer](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.AuthorizationServer.JwtBearer.md): The resource server's half of the Identity Assertion JWT Authorization Grant
(ID-JAG), the grant behind MCP Enterprise-Managed Authorization (EMA) -
`draft-ietf-oauth-identity-assertion-authz-grant-04`.
- [AttestoPhoenix.AuthorizationServer.PAR](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.AuthorizationServer.PAR.md): Pushed Authorization Request storage (RFC 9126), as conn-free core.
- [AttestoPhoenix.AuthorizationServer.PAR.Request](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.AuthorizationServer.PAR.Request.md): A parsed Pushed Authorization Request (RFC 9126), all plain data lifted at
the controller edge.
- [AttestoPhoenix.AuthorizationServer.RequestObjectMetadata](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.AuthorizationServer.RequestObjectMetadata.md): Conn-free derivation of the signed-request-object (JAR / RFC 9101 §10.5)
discovery metadata shared by the OpenID Provider Metadata document (OpenID
Connect Discovery) and the OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata document
(RFC 8414).
- [AttestoPhoenix.AuthorizationServer.RequestPolicy](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.AuthorizationServer.RequestPolicy.md): Conn-free resolution of the per-request authorization-request validation
policy shared by the authorization endpoint and the PAR endpoint.
- [AttestoPhoenix.AuthorizationServer.SenderConstraint](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.AuthorizationServer.SenderConstraint.md): Sender-constraint resolution for the token endpoint (RFC 9449 / RFC 8705),
as conn-free core.
- [AttestoPhoenix.AuthorizationServer.Token](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.AuthorizationServer.Token.md): Token-endpoint grant processing (RFC 6749 §3.2), as conn-free core.
- [AttestoPhoenix.AuthorizationServer.Token.Request](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.AuthorizationServer.Token.Request.md): A parsed token request, all plain data lifted at the controller edge.
- [AttestoPhoenix.BackChannelLogout](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.BackChannelLogout.md): The seam for delivering a Back-Channel Logout `logout_token` to a Relying
Party (OpenID Connect Back-Channel Logout 1.0 §2.5).
- [AttestoPhoenix.BackChannelLogout.Req](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.BackChannelLogout.Req.md): Default `AttestoPhoenix.BackChannelLogout` deliverer, built on `Req`.
- [AttestoPhoenix.Callback](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Callback.md): Invocation of configured callbacks in the forms accepted throughout the
library.
- [AttestoPhoenix.ClaimsProvider](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.ClaimsProvider.md): The host-owned UserInfo claim source (OpenID Connect Core §5).
- [AttestoPhoenix.ClientAuthentication](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.ClientAuthentication.md): OAuth 2.0 client authentication (RFC 6749 §2.3), as conn-free core.
- [AttestoPhoenix.ClientAuthentication.ErrorContext](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.ClientAuthentication.ErrorContext.md): Transport facts known while classifying client authentication.
- [AttestoPhoenix.ClientAuthentication.Policy](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.ClientAuthentication.Policy.md): The per-caller policy for `AttestoPhoenix.ClientAuthentication`.
- [AttestoPhoenix.ClientAuthentication.Result](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.ClientAuthentication.Result.md): The authenticated client and how it authenticated.
- [AttestoPhoenix.ClientIdMetadata](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.ClientIdMetadata.md): Integration façade for Client ID Metadata Documents - CIMD
(`draft-ietf-oauth-client-id-metadata-document-01`, IETF OAuth WG).
- [AttestoPhoenix.ClientIdMetadata.Cache](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.ClientIdMetadata.Cache.md): Behaviour for caching a validated Client ID Metadata Document - CIMD
(`draft-ietf-oauth-client-id-metadata-document-01`, IETF OAuth WG).
- [AttestoPhoenix.ClientIdMetadata.Cache.ETS](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.ClientIdMetadata.Cache.ETS.md): Single-node ETS `AttestoPhoenix.ClientIdMetadata.Cache` - CIMD
(`draft-ietf-oauth-client-id-metadata-document-01`, IETF OAuth WG).
- [AttestoPhoenix.ClientIdMetadata.Cache.Ecto](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.ClientIdMetadata.Cache.Ecto.md): Postgres-backed `AttestoPhoenix.ClientIdMetadata.Cache` for clustered
deployments - CIMD (`draft-ietf-oauth-client-id-metadata-document-01`, IETF
OAuth WG).
- [AttestoPhoenix.ClientIdMetadata.Fetcher](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.ClientIdMetadata.Fetcher.md): Behaviour for dereferencing a Client ID Metadata Document URL - CIMD
(`draft-ietf-oauth-client-id-metadata-document-01`, IETF OAuth WG).
- [AttestoPhoenix.ClientIdMetadata.Fetcher.Req](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.ClientIdMetadata.Fetcher.Req.md): The default, SSRF-guarded Client ID Metadata Document fetcher - CIMD
(`draft-ietf-oauth-client-id-metadata-document-01`, IETF OAuth WG).
- [AttestoPhoenix.ClientIdMetadata.Resolver](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.ClientIdMetadata.Resolver.md): Resolves a Client ID Metadata Document URL into a client - CIMD
(`draft-ietf-oauth-client-id-metadata-document-01`, IETF OAuth WG).
- [AttestoPhoenix.ConsentGrant](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.ConsentGrant.md): The request binding a single-use consent grant is tied to, and the canonical
hash over it (RFC 6749 §4.1.1).
- [AttestoPhoenix.ConsentGrantStore](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.ConsentGrantStore.md): Behaviour for single-use, request-bound consent grants (RFC 6749 §4.1.1).
- [AttestoPhoenix.Controller.AuthorizeController](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Controller.AuthorizeController.md): OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect authorization endpoint (RFC 6749 §3.1,
OIDC Core §3.1.2).
- [AttestoPhoenix.Controller.DeviceAuthorizationController](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Controller.DeviceAuthorizationController.md): OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Endpoint (RFC 8628 §3.1).
- [AttestoPhoenix.Controller.DeviceVerificationController](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Controller.DeviceVerificationController.md): Device verification page (RFC 8628 §3.3).
- [AttestoPhoenix.Controller.EndSessionController](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Controller.EndSessionController.md): End-session endpoint (OpenID Connect RP-Initiated Logout 1.0 §2 +
Back-Channel Logout 1.0).
- [AttestoPhoenix.Controller.IntrospectionController](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Controller.IntrospectionController.md): `POST /oauth/introspect` - OAuth 2.0 Token Introspection (RFC 7662), with the
signed-JWT response of RFC 9701 (FAPI 2.0 Message Signing §5.5).
- [AttestoPhoenix.Controller.OpenIDConfigurationController](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Controller.OpenIDConfigurationController.md): OpenID Connect Discovery 1.0 - OpenID Provider Metadata endpoint.
- [AttestoPhoenix.Controller.ProtectedResourceController](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Controller.ProtectedResourceController.md): RFC 9728 - OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata endpoint.
- [AttestoPhoenix.Plug.Authenticate](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Plug.Authenticate.md): Phoenix-friendly protected-resource authentication.
- [AttestoPhoenix.Plug.RequireScopes](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Plug.RequireScopes.md): Phoenix alias for `Attesto.Plug.RequireScopes`.
- [AttestoPhoenix.Schema.ClientIdMetadata](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Schema.ClientIdMetadata.md): Ecto schema for one cached Client ID Metadata Document - CIMD
(`draft-ietf-oauth-client-id-metadata-document-01`, IETF OAuth WG).
- [AttestoPhoenix.Schema.ConsentGrant](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Schema.ConsentGrant.md): Ecto schema for a single-use, request-bound consent grant (RFC 6749 §4.1.1).
- [AttestoPhoenix.Schema.DeviceCode](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Schema.DeviceCode.md): Ecto schema + record bridge for the RFC 8628 device-code store
(`AttestoPhoenix.Store.EctoDeviceCodeStore`).
- [AttestoPhoenix.Schema.LogoutSession](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Schema.LogoutSession.md): Ecto schema + record bridge for the Back-Channel Logout session store
(`AttestoPhoenix.Store.EctoLogoutSessionStore`).
- [AttestoPhoenix.Schema.PushedAuthorizationRequest](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Schema.PushedAuthorizationRequest.md): Ecto schema for a single Pushed Authorization Request (RFC 9126).
- [AttestoPhoenix.Store.EctoConsentGrantStore](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Store.EctoConsentGrantStore.md): Postgres-backed `AttestoPhoenix.ConsentGrantStore` (RFC 6749 §4.1.1).
- [AttestoPhoenix.Store.EctoDeviceCodeStore](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Store.EctoDeviceCodeStore.md): Ecto/Postgres implementation of `Attesto.DeviceCodeStore`.
- [AttestoPhoenix.Store.EctoLogoutSessionStore](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Store.EctoLogoutSessionStore.md): Ecto/Postgres implementation of `Attesto.LogoutSessionStore`.
- [AttestoPhoenix.Store.EctoPARStore](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Store.EctoPARStore.md): Postgres-backed `AttestoPhoenix.PARStore` for clustered deployments
(RFC 9126).
- [AttestoPhoenix.Store.NonceStore](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Store.NonceStore.md): Dispatch to the configured `Attesto.DPoP.NonceStore`, threading the live
request `%AttestoPhoenix.Config{}` to stores that need it (RFC 9449 §8).

- Setup
  - [AttestoPhoenix](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.md): A Phoenix/Ecto OAuth 2.0 / OIDC authorization-server and
resource-server layer built on top of `Attesto`.
  - [AttestoPhoenix.Config](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Config.md): Configuration for the `attesto_phoenix` authorization-server layer.
  - [AttestoPhoenix.Router](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Router.md): Router macro that mounts the authorization-server endpoints.

- Host contracts (behaviours)
  - [AttestoPhoenix.ClientStore](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.ClientStore.md): The host-owned OAuth client registry contract (RFC 6749 §2 / §3.1.2).
  - [AttestoPhoenix.ConsentPolicy](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.ConsentPolicy.md): The host-owned resource-owner authentication and consent contract
(RFC 6749 §3.1 / §4.1.1, OpenID Connect Core §3.1.2).
  - [AttestoPhoenix.EventSink](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.EventSink.md): The host-owned audit/telemetry contract.
  - [AttestoPhoenix.PrincipalStore](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.PrincipalStore.md): The host-owned subject/principal contract.
  - [AttestoPhoenix.RegistrationStore](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.RegistrationStore.md): The host-owned dynamic client registration persistence contract
(RFC 7591 §3 / RFC 7592 §2).
  - [AttestoPhoenix.ScopePolicy](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.ScopePolicy.md): The host-owned scope-authorization contract (RFC 6749 §3.3).

- Controllers
  - [AttestoPhoenix.Controller.DiscoveryController](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Controller.DiscoveryController.md): RFC 8414 - OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata endpoint.
  - [AttestoPhoenix.Controller.JWKSController](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Controller.JWKSController.md): `GET /.well-known/jwks.json` - the JSON Web Key Set (RFC 7517 §5).
  - [AttestoPhoenix.Controller.PARController](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Controller.PARController.md): Pushed Authorization Request endpoint (RFC 9126).
  - [AttestoPhoenix.Controller.RegistrationController](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Controller.RegistrationController.md): OAuth 2.0 Dynamic Client Registration endpoint (RFC 7591 §3).
  - [AttestoPhoenix.Controller.RevocationController](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Controller.RevocationController.md): `POST /oauth/revoke` - OAuth 2.0 Token Revocation (RFC 7009).
  - [AttestoPhoenix.Controller.TokenController](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Controller.TokenController.md): OAuth 2.0 token endpoint (RFC 6749 §3.2).
  - [AttestoPhoenix.Controller.UserinfoController](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Controller.UserinfoController.md): OpenID Connect UserInfo endpoint (OpenID Connect Core 1.0 §5.3).

- OpenAPI
  - [AttestoPhoenix.OpenAPI.TokenEndpoint](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.OpenAPI.TokenEndpoint.md): OpenApiSpex operation and schema values for the OAuth 2.0 token endpoint.

- Stores
  - [AttestoPhoenix.Store.EctoCodeStore](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Store.EctoCodeStore.md): Ecto implementation of the `Attesto.CodeStore` behaviour.
  - [AttestoPhoenix.Store.EctoNonceStore](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Store.EctoNonceStore.md): Postgres-backed `Attesto.DPoP.NonceStore` for clustered deployments
(RFC 9449 §8).
  - [AttestoPhoenix.Store.EctoRefreshStore](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Store.EctoRefreshStore.md): Ecto implementation of the `Attesto.RefreshStore` behaviour.
  - [AttestoPhoenix.Store.EctoReplayCheck](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Store.EctoReplayCheck.md): Ecto-backed, shared-store `jti` replay check for DPoP proofs
(RFC 9449 §11.1).
  - [AttestoPhoenix.Store.PAR.ETS](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Store.PAR.ETS.md): Single-node ETS Pushed Authorization Request store.
  - [AttestoPhoenix.Store.Sweeper](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Store.Sweeper.md): Optional periodic housekeeping `GenServer` that deletes expired rows from the
Ecto-backed authorization-code, refresh-token, DPoP-nonce, DPoP-replay,
pushed-authorization-request, client-id-metadata-cache, and consent-grant
tables.

- Schemas
  - [AttestoPhoenix.Schema.Authorization](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Schema.Authorization.md): Ecto schema for the single-use authorization codes backing an
`Attesto.CodeStore`.
  - [AttestoPhoenix.Schema.DPoPNonce](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Schema.DPoPNonce.md): Ecto schema for a single server-issued DPoP nonce (RFC 9449 §8).
  - [AttestoPhoenix.Schema.DPoPReplay](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Schema.DPoPReplay.md): Ecto schema for one recorded DPoP proof `jti` (JWT ID).
  - [AttestoPhoenix.Schema.RefreshToken](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Schema.RefreshToken.md): Ecto schema for the refresh-token records that back an Ecto-backed
`Attesto.RefreshStore`.

- Shared
  - [AttestoPhoenix.Event](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.Event.md): Neutral event struct and dispatcher for the optional `:on_event` callback.
  - [AttestoPhoenix.OAuthError](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.OAuthError.md): The error value type and the wire-rendering helpers for the
authorization-server controllers and the protected-resource plugs.
  - [AttestoPhoenix.PARStore](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.PARStore.md): Behaviour for Pushed Authorization Request storage (RFC 9126).
  - [AttestoPhoenix.RequestContext](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AttestoPhoenix.RequestContext.md): Neutral request-fact helpers the OAuth 2.0 / OIDC flows derive from a `Plug.Conn`.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix attesto_phoenix.gen.migration](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AttestoPhoenix.Gen.Migration.md): Generates an Ecto migration that creates the persistence backing the
Ecto-based stores ship with `attesto_phoenix`.
- [mix attesto_phoenix.install](https://attesto-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AttestoPhoenix.Install.md): Installs the attesto_phoenix authorization-server layer into a Phoenix app
